wargear.name: Death-mask
wargear.summary: A gilded helm cast in the austere, grieving face of the Primarch.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Death-mask has the Fear (1) Special Rule and adds 1 to its Leadership Characteristic.

wargear.name: Grail of the Red Tide
wargear.summary: A chalice of sanctified blood carried with the unit and shared before the charge.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Grail of the Red Tide, all Models in that Unit have the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule. If the Model carrying the Grail is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Wing-blade pinions
wargear.summary: Razored pinions fitted to a jump pack.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Wing-blade pinions has the Pinion Strike Special Rule.

wargear.name: Pennon of Baal
wargear.summary: A blood-red pennon sewn with the names of the dead.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Pennon of Baal, all Models in that Unit have the Rise Again Special Rule. If the Model carrying the Pennon is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Rage-wracked pilot
wargear.summary: The sarcophagus occupant has been fed a little too much of the Thirst.
wargear.text: A Walker equipped with a Rage-wracked pilot adds 1 to its Weapon Skill Characteristic and has the Waking Nightmare Special Rule.

wargear.name: Haloed aegis
wargear.summary: A gilt field projector worn like a halo.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Haloed aegis has an Invulnerable Save of 5+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save, and has the Aegis of Light Special Rule.

wargear.name: Crimson ablative lacquer
wargear.summary: Layers of sacrificial lacquer burned away by the first hit.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Crimson ablative lacquer has the Ablative Coat Special Rule.

wargear.name: Dawnlight lamps
wargear.summary: Floodlamp arrays that turn night into noon.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Dawnlight lamps has the Dawnlight Special Rule.

wargear.name: Rage-draught
wargear.summary: A flask of the Apothecary's darkest brew.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Rage-draught has the Rage-Draught Surge Special Rule.

wargear.name: Halo of Dawn-gold
wargear.summary: A circlet of beaten gold that catches the light and blinds the eye.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Halo of Dawn-gold has the Gilded Radiance Special Rule.

rules.name: Sun Behind Them
rules.summary: The first wave lands before the enemy can react.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule that arrives from Reserves by Deep Strike may declare a Charge in the Battle Turn in which it arrives.

rules.name: The Red Thirst
rules.summary: The blood is up and nothing will hold it back.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule adds 1 to the result of its Charge Rolls. When it destroys an enemy Unit in an Assault, it may immediately make a Set-up Move of up to 3" towards the nearest enemy Unit. At the start of its Assault phase, if an enemy Unit is within 12", the Unit must declare a Charge against one enemy Unit if able.

rules.name: Unbroken Court
rules.summary: The Host's finest do not break while the Angel's own watch.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic when it makes a Morale Check. While it is within 6" of a friendly Model with the Warlord or High Command role, it passes Morale Checks automatically.

rules.name: Entombed Rage
rules.summary: Cut off from the world, the occupant has only fury left.
rules.text: When a Unit with this Special Rule is charged, its Models fight at their normal Initiative Characteristic and add 1 to their Attacks Characteristic for that Assault. A Unit with this Special Rule also has the Fear (1) Special Rule.

rules.name: Pinion Strike
rules.summary: The razored wings carve a path before the blade falls.
rules.text: In the Battle Turn in which a Model with this Special Rule makes a Charge, it adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic for the first round of the Assault, and each Melee Weapon it wields has the Impact (S) Special Rule.

rules.name: Rise Again
rules.summary: The names on the pennon will not let the Host fall.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Controlling Player's Battle Turn, a Unit with this Special Rule removes every Tactical Status it has.

rules.name: Waking Nightmare
rules.summary: What stares out from the sarcophagus is no longer sane.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Fear (1) Special Rule. When it makes a Charge Roll of less than 6, the result is treated as a 6.

rules.name: Aegis of Light
rules.summary: The halo flares at the first sword stroke.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has an Invulnerable Save of 4+ against attacks made in the Assault phase.

rules.name: Ablative Coat
rules.summary: The lacquer burns away so the hull does not have to.
rules.text: The first Hull Point that a Vehicle with this Special Rule would lose during a battle is ignored.

rules.name: Dawnlight
rules.summary: The lamps strip every shadow from the target.
rules.text: Shooting Attacks made by a Vehicle with this Special Rule against a Unit within 12" ignore the Shrouded (X) Special Rule and any Cover Save granted by darkness.

rules.name: Rage-Draught Surge
rules.summary: One swallow turns a warrior into a storm.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Assault phase, the Controlling Player may declare a Rage-Draught Surge for the Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule. Until the end of that phase, all Models in the Unit add 1 to their Strength Characteristic. At the end of that phase, they subtract 1 from their Initiative Characteristic until the end of their next Battle Turn.

rules.name: Seraph of Baal
rules.summary: The Angel in full radiance, swift as light and as easily marked.
rules.text: This Model adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic and adds 2 to the result of its Charge Rolls. This Model subtracts 1 from its Toughness Characteristic.

rules.name: The Black Rage Stirs
rules.summary: The vision of his own death takes hold, and the blade moves of its own accord.
rules.text: This Model adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic. This Model subtracts 2 from its Willpower Characteristic.

rules.name: The Sorrowing Seraph
rules.summary: He grieves for the sons he is about to lose, and they take heart from his grief.
rules.text: Friendly Blood Angels Units within 9" of this Model add 1 to their Cool Characteristic. This Model subtracts 1 from its Weapon Skill Characteristic and 1 from its Attacks Characteristic.

rules.name: Gilded Radiance
rules.summary: The enemy cannot look at him and still strike true.
rules.text: Enemy Units that Declare a Charge against a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule subtract 1 from the result of their Charge Roll. Hit Tests made against a Model with this Special Rule as part of a Reaction are made with a -1 modifier.

rules.name: Sorrowsong
rules.summary: A pistol that sings as it fires, and the wounded remember the note.
rules.text: An enemy Unit that suffers one or more Unsaved Wounds from a Shooting Attack made with the Sorrowsong pistol subtracts 1 from its Leadership Characteristic until the end of the current Battle Turn.

rites.name: The Descent of the Host
rites.flavor: They fall in a spray of gold, and the sun is behind them.
benefits: Dawnbreaker Cohorts and the Angel's Tears may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They also gain Sun Behind Them: they may declare a Charge in the Battle Turn in which they arrive by Deep Strike.
Every Antigrav Infantry unit gains +1 Initiative.
limitations: At least two Assault Squads or Veteran Assault Squads are required.
Dawnbreaker Cohorts and the Angel's Tears must start the battle in Reserve.
No Heavy sub-type Infantry, no Armour and no Heavy Transports.

modifiers.text: The Descent of the Host: Line (1), Sun Behind Them.
The Descent of the Host: +1 I.

require.note: Bring at least two Assault Squads or Veteran Assault Squads.

rites.name: Thirst of the Red Wings
rites.flavor: Sanguinius could hold the rage in his sons. Without him it was a tide.
benefits: Every non-Vehicle Model adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic in a Battle Turn in which its Unit makes a Charge.
Every non-Vehicle Unit gains The Red Thirst: +1 to Charge Rolls, and a Set-up Move of up to 3" towards the enemy after destroying a Unit in an Assault.
limitations: Every non-Vehicle Model subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic.
Units with The Red Thirst must declare a Charge if an enemy Unit is within 12" at the start of their Assault phase.
No Apothecaries, no Recon units and no Support units other than Techmarines.

modifiers.text: Thirst of the Red Wings: +1 A.
modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

modifiers.text: Thirst of the Red Wings: -1 CL, The Red Thirst.

rites.name: The Celestial Court
rites.flavor: A Legion of ten thousand, and only the finest ever walk in the Primarch's shadow.
benefits: Sanguinary Guard, Crimson Paladins and Ofanim Courts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (2).
They also gain Unbroken Court: +1 Cool Characteristic for Morale Checks, passing them automatically within 6" of a friendly Warlord or High Command Model.
limitations: At least one Sanguinary Guard and one Crimson Paladin pack are required.
No Tactical Squads, Despoiler Squads or Inductii.

modifiers.text: The Celestial Court: Line (2), Unbroken Court.

require.note: Bring at least one Sanguinary Guard.
Bring at least one Crimson Paladin pack.

rites.name: Pyre-Brothers of Baal
rites.flavor: The old ones burn, and they remember. They are very, very angry.
benefits: Contemptor-Incaendius Dreadnoughts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Entombed Rage: when charged they fight at their normal Initiative Characteristic with +1 Attacks, and they gain Fear (1).
Every Walker adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic.
limitations: At least two Contemptor-Incaendius are required.
No Recon units and no Heavy Transports.

modifiers.text: Pyre-Brothers of Baal: Line (1), Entombed Rage.
Pyre-Brothers of Baal: +1 A.

require.note: Bring at least two Contemptor-Incaendius Dreadnoughts.

armyRules.name: Wings of the Angel
armyRules.flavor: The Host falls on the enemy from the sky.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule adds 2 to the result of its Charge Rolls.
drawbacks: If a Unit with this Special Rule fails a Charge, its Models subtract 1 from their Initiative Characteristic until the end of the Controlling Player's next Battle Turn.

armyRules.name: Sanguine Grace
armyRules.flavor: A noble duellist with the Angel's own poise.
benefits: In a Challenge, a Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic.
drawbacks: Once a Model with this Special Rule has lost a Wound, it must pass a Willpower Check at the start of each of its Controlling Player's Battle Turns. On a failure, it must declare a Charge against the nearest enemy Unit if able.

armyRules.name: Rage of the Fallen
armyRules.flavor: Each fallen brother feeds the fury of those who remain.
benefits: When a Model in a Unit with this Special Rule is removed as a casualty in the Assault phase, all remaining Models in that Unit add 1 to their Attacks Characteristic until the end of that phase. This bonus cannot be gained more than once in a phase.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule cannot voluntarily Fall Back.
armyRules.condition: after losing a Model in the Assault phase: +1 A until the end of the phase

armyRules.name: Wings Above the Host
armyRules.flavor: Where the Angel burns above the line, his sons find a calm they could not keep alone.
benefits: While Sanguinius is on the battlefield, friendly Blood Angels Infantry Models within 12" of him add 1 to their Willpower Characteristic.
drawbacks: If Sanguinius is removed as a casualty, every friendly Blood Angels Unit must make a Willpower Check; a Unit that fails must Declare a Charge against the nearest enemy Unit in its Controlling Player's next Assault Phase if able, and cannot Fall Back until the end of the following Battle Turn.
